I purchased a snake in took her to the vet because I seen small bugs crawling on her which was crazy because she is the only pet in first reptile boa snake. So I put her in her new enclosure in begin to monitor her re cleaning the tank before use in everything. Than I noticed she would soak in her bowl of water in read up on it they said they do this to drown what I now know is mites. Mites are the worst if In contact with human it would give them a skin disease called scabies. But it also irritates the animal like reptile fleas which I know came from this pet shop. I have evidence pictures and videos with the vet bill. I have contacted the shop when I call the lady who does not speak English keep answering. So no one there to that speak to which is Ludicrous I don’t know if I should get my lawyer in sue because I paid $275 for the snake with $50 worth of snake enclosure items which I had to throw away from this exact place. Plus 135$ for vet  visit in $70 for treatment for my snake THATS not including my new enclosure thank god I didn’t buy from here. I’m so mad in furious with this pet shop they need to rectify the issue or court documents will be sent.
